text: Render rebuilding status and lock terminal input in the Watchdog UI
description: Display a rebuild progress overlay and disable user inputs during relaunch transitions, restoring session automation upon reconnection.

status.comment: Rebuild progress overlay and terminal input lock implemented and internally verified. Awaiting explicit user acceptance before done.

reflection: Completed the rebuild-transition UI. The broker now exposes its existing in-flight rebuild state through getStatus; the frontend polls it while attached, immediately marks manual relaunches, blocks worker and supervisor input at both store and terminal boundaries, and renders an accessible rebuilding overlay until status clears/reconnection completes. Added focused panel/store tests. Verification: wrapped-agents-broker type-check passes, broker tests 8/8 pass, frontend tests 209/209 pass, frontend production build passes.
